sources.title: 中华人民共和国药典（2025年版）网络版入口
sources.use: Confirms the official 2025 online pharmacopoeia portal. Direct Wu Gong monograph body was not retrievable in this research pass.

sources.title: 中国药典2025年版 凡例（蒲标网镜像）
sources.use: General rule: unless otherwise specified, decoction-piece dosage is the adult usual daily dose; toxicity labels and 注意 are safety-relevant.

sources.title: 至宝丹（大医网）
sources.use: Xiong Huang 30 g appears as a whole-formula batch ingredient; modern pill 3 g, one pill once daily.

sources.title: 苏合香丸（中国药典2020镜像）
sources.use: Zhu Sha 100 g in formula batch; makes 960 pills; one pill 1–2 times daily.

sources.title: 苏合香丸（中医世家，含《局方》与药典条目）
sources.use: Preserves classical Su He Xiang Wan composition with Zhu Sha 二两 and a parenthetical modern conversion; also reproduces pharmacopoeial 100 g / 960-pill formula.

sources.title: 乌梅丸（中国药典2020标准镜像）
sources.use: Xi Xin 18 g in formula batch; water pills or large honey pills; water pill dose 3 g, large honey pill 2 pills, 2–3 times/day; no explicit output count for the batch.

sources.title: 细辛（中国药典2025年版镜像）
sources.use: Adult usual dose 1–3 g; powder 0.5–1 g per dose. Supports separation from formula-batch amount.

sources.title: 小活络丸（中国药典2020标准镜像）
sources.use: Zhi Chuan Wu 180 g and Zhi Cao Wu 180 g are batch ingredients; every 100 g powder receives 120–130 g refined honey. No explicit final pill count in the cited standard.

sources.title: 小活络丹（香港浸会大学中医药学院方剂数据库）
sources.use: Source attributed to 太平惠民和剂局方; displays 制川乌/制草乌各180 g and 3 g dosing in the modern database presentation.

sources.title: 《太平惠民和剂局方》活络丹（维基文库公开转录）
sources.use: Classical source preserves 川乌/草乌等各六两 and administration by pill count; does not itself provide a modern gram conversion.

sources.title: 雄黄（中国药典2025年版镜像）
sources.use: 0.05–0.1 g, pills/powders; toxic; internal use cautious, not prolonged; contraindicated in pregnancy.

sources.title: 朱砂（中国药典2025年版镜像）
sources.use: 0.1–0.5 g; mainly pills/powders, not decocted; toxic; no large/prolonged low-dose use; pregnancy and hepatic/renal insufficiency contraindicated.

sources.title: 蜈蚣（中国药典2015镜像，legacy comparator only）
sources.use: Legacy comparator only: 3–5 g; toxic; pregnancy contraindicated. Not eligible for 2025 canonical ingestion without current monograph verification.

sources.title: 蜈蚣饮片追溯页（执行《中国药典》2025年版一部）
sources.use: Confirms a current Wu Gong decoction-piece lot executes ChP 2025 Part I, but does not expose the monograph dose/toxicity/pregnancy clauses.

sources.title: 仲景方用药度量衡古今折算标准研究
sources.use: Research estimates Eastern Han 1 liang = 15 g and explicitly notes historical metrology differs from modern units.

sources.title: 论张仲景对方药的计量只能用东汉官制
sources.use: A different scholarly estimate gives Eastern Han 1 liang = 13.8 g, demonstrating that conversion itself can be contested and must carry provenance.

sources.title: 中国医用度量衡发展概况
sources.use: Documents historical change in Chinese medical metrology and inconsistent later conversion standards.

sources.title: 国家市场监督管理总局：金、银重量单位换算表（市制16两制）
sources.use: For explicitly identified 市制（16两=1斤） only: 1 liang = 31.25 g, 1 qian = 3.125 g. This is not a universal historical-dynasty conversion.

sources.title: 国家药监局古代经典名方目录/关键信息表样例
sources.use: Official tables preserve original text, prescription, preparation and administration as separate evidence; supports storing original units separately from normalized values.

sources.title: 一清颗粒（中国药典2025年版镜像）
sources.use: Example of a fifth dose semantics: each 1 g finished product is equivalent to 0.98 g decoction pieces.

sources.title: 安宫牛黄丸课程材料（AcuTing File Library）
sources.use: Course source shows Xiong Huang 30 and Zhu Sha 30 in a formula table while administration is 3 g pills; supports same-pattern suspicion, not canonical pharmacopoeial adjudication.

sources.title: 紫雪丹课程材料（AcuTing File Library）
sources.use: Course source shows Zhu Sha 90 in a batch-scale table and administration 1.5–3 g per dose; supports same-pattern suspicion.

sources.title: FORMULA_EYESON_02.md / current repo audit
sources.use: Records current problematic values: An Gong Niu Huang Wan Xiong Huang 1–30 g, Zhu Sha .5–30 g; Ci Zhu Wan Zhu Sha 3–30 g; Su He Xiang Wan Zhu Sha .5–60 g.

sources.title: FORMULA_EYESON_03.md / current repo audit
